text:
I have left the door ajar.

I am an animal that does not resign itself

to dying. Eternity

is the dark hinge that gives way,

a small noise in the night

of flesh.

I am the island that advances, sustained

by death, or a city

fiercely besieged

by life,

or perhaps I am nothing,

only insomnia

and the brilliant indifference of the stars, desert, inexorable destiny, the sun of the living rises, I recognize that door, there is no other, spring ice and a thorn of blood in the eye of the rose.

translation.title: Final Scene
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the ajar door, hinge of eternity, and the compressed final sentence of cosmic indifference.
